record: The biome game in a browser: docs/BIOME_GAMEPLAY.md §6
pass: the page asking about a place on the land is told what would come: "Creek timber, at the edge of the timber, a quarter mile south-west of the house. Good ground for deer: the wait should not be long. Deer and turkey keep to it. Waiting here, a turkey: four food."
the shot is asked about the place's quarry, "Alvin Proofwright is downwind of a turkey, with a shot to take. It is not a close one.", and the turkey is drawn as a turkey
the family is told what was brought down: "Alvin Proofwright brought down a turkey: 5 food came home. The rest, 0.6 food, was more than Alvin Proofwright could carry and was left where it fell."

the family panel offers one felling icon, "Fell trees": "Go out with the felling axe to the nearest timber on the family’s land; the logs go onto the pile at the house.", painted; no fetch or haul icon
a cleared plot says how its fence would go up: "Ten acres of prairie beside the house, cleared, with no fence. Rails split from the timber at hand: about 1.5 hours."
no page errors anywhere in the run
